questions.question:
Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides. X sits second to the left of W. W sits in one of the corners. V is the immediate neighbour of T and U. R. sits third to the left of T. U does not sit in one of the corners. U is neither the neighbour of X nor W. Q is not the neighbour of X.

How many people sit between S and V, when counted from the left of S?
questions.solution:
Given :

 
• Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table.
 
• Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides.

Explanation :

1) W sits in one of the corners.

2) X sits second to the left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07dcbe0615734389c0d59c1a36e4f6efa140864558403816dbdde3f16f68bca5.png] 

3) U does not sit in one of the corners.

4) V is the immediate neighbour of T and U.

As position of V is not know yet therefore there possible positions for V.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00e2affe5f15bea3d7f16406c937e66ca5869ff7e8e80d575c0520242eb7d773.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfb1b42c4926fa04d5d34fd838cd58f38f0e27e2e27bd509de9ff31bebea69e1.png] 

5) R sits third to the left of T.

6) U is neither the neighbour of X nor W.

7) Q is not the neighbour of X.

As there is no possible position for R in case - (2) therefore, case - (2) is eliminated.

After positioning R and Q only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e S.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3b85b092b8dbb26c81898b07cfd4fa4ef8c5919906f85d5512cf34252009360.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement two people i.e X and T sit between S and V, when counted from the left of S.

Hence, "Two" is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 7th May 2000 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 15th July 2010?
questions.solution:
Given : 7th May 2000 was Sunday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 7th May 2000 to 15th July 2010 :

 365 days - 31 January - 28 February - 31 March - 30 April - 7 May = 242 days
 238 ÷ 7 = 0

 (1 × 7) + (2 × 2) = 11
 11 ÷ 7 = 4

 **4**
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 7th May 2000 to 15th July 2010 ⇒ 4

⇒So, Four odd day get added to Monday because day asked in future.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow's from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some doughnuts are rocks.

All rocks are papers.

Some papers are oil.

**Conclusion I: **Some doughnuts are papers.

**Conclusion II: **Some rocks are oil.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2106c35c142c8072a0c9a0390ff5afb30de51105843920de260afd477906f846.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some doughnuts are papers → **F**ollow (As some doughnuts are rocks and all rocks are papers. So, as some part of doughnuts is common with rocks which whole comes in papers therefore it is definitely true)

II. Some rocks are oil → Does not follow (As all rocks are papers and some papers are oil. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follow. 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some glass are pink.

All pink are bags.

Some bags are flowers.

**Conclusion I:** Some pink are glass.

**Conclusion II:** Some flowers are bags.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9cd0db2b0bc9f3f9f60d6a008be9b8d5cabfb316f89e1bc8db2f9c9423639e2.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pink are glass → Follow (As, some glass are pink. So, as some part of glass is common with pink therefore it is definitely true.)

II. Some flowers are bags → Follow (As, some bags are flowers. So, as some part of bags is common with flower therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".
